verdict.rationale: Poke's docs say it supports MCP servers 'to extend Poke with custom tools and data sources'. They document a CLI command to add a remote MCP server and a tunnel for local MCP servers, and note that 'any MCP-compatible server' can be connected directly when no Recipe exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connected MCP tools work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Poke supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, allowing you to extend Poke with custom tools and data sources.
npx poke@latest mcp add https://mcp.example.com/sse -n "My Server"
If the service you want isn't available as a Recipe, you can connect any MCP-compatible server directly
npx poke@latest tunnel http://localhost:3000/mcp -n "Local Dev MCP"
